steps.what: Prepare maintenance standards from held maintenance notes.

loop.input: a note id and one sentence from that note
loop.output: a sentence kept only when that note states it
loop.check: The sentence cites a note id and the note text contains it.
loop.stop: Stop when there is no note id, or the note does not state the sentence. The technician writes that part.
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed list cannot keep a sentence that only one maintenance note states, and it must not keep a sentence the note does not state.

steps.what: Review the drafted maintenance standards and accept one version.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store holds the maintenance notes. A sentence is drafted into the standard only when that note states it, and the draft stops when the note does not. The engineering technician reviews, develops, or prepares the rest, and accepts one version. Only that accepted version is filed.
tasks.previous_blocker: A standard was filled with sentences the maintenance notes never stated.
tasks.enabler_now: A note that states a sentence can be copied into the draft. The review and the rest of the writing still belong to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A standard the notes do not cover still has to be written by the technician.
tasks.human_edge: The technician reviews and accepts the standard. A sentence the note does not state is not drafted.
tasks.altitude: The review stays with the technician. The standard is filed only after that version is accepted.

reach.task: Follow a standard this technician has accepted.
reach.learn: A note title is not the standard.

evidence.claim: Copying a sentence a held maintenance note already states is a draft of that sentence. It is not a review of the standard.
Filing a standard before the technician accepts that version would publish a rule nobody reviewed.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The note id and the note text already stored. A sentence is kept only when that text states it. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Draft from the note text. Do not keep a sentence the note does not state.
Any edit after approval voids the version and returns the item to the engineering technician.
unknowns: Whether every maintenance standard has a held note, or some are written from scratch.
research_questions: Who confirms a note is the held source for this standard?

already_counted.description: Reviewing and completing the maintenance standard stay with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

approvals.approved_version: note ids and the standard text the technician accepted

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still reviews, develops, and prepares the maintenance standard, including every sentence the notes do not state. Only drafting a sentence a held note already states, and filing the standard already accepted, is removed. A note title saves none of the review.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored defect on this component.
Replace defective components or parts with precision instruments.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the defect note already written. The engineering technician replaces the defective component or part with hand tools and precision instruments. The note does not make the replacement. An instrument that already shows a reading is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A part was marked replaced because a defect title existed, and the old part was still fitted.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored defect can be opened. The replacement still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A fit the note does not describe still has to be made on the bench.
tasks.human_edge: The technician replaces the part. The note is the defect already written.
tasks.altitude: Replacement stays with the technician. The instrument's reading is not the labour.

reach.task: Fit the part this technician is replacing.
reach.learn: A defect title is not the replacement.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored defect note is a lookup. It does not replace a component or a part.
Time a precision instrument already spends showing a reading is not the technician's replacement labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The defect id already stored. The screen does not mark the part replaced. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the defect note before the replacement.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether component defects and part defects share one note.
research_questions: Who confirms the note matches the part now fitted?

already_counted.description: Replacing the defective component or part stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose equipment record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still replaces the defective component or part with hand tools and precision instruments. Only opening a defect note that was already written is removed. An instrument that already shows a reading saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored control architecture for this unit.
Integrate software or hardware components on that architecture.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the control architecture already written. The engineering technician integrates the software or hardware components using the computer, the microprocessor, or that architecture. The note does not integrate them. A compiler or controller that already runs is not this time.
tasks.previous_blocker: A component was marked integrated because the architecture named it, and it had not been connected.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored architecture can be opened. The integration still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A mismatch the architecture does not describe still has to be resolved on the unit.
tasks.human_edge: The technician integrates the components. The architecture note is not that work.
tasks.altitude: Integration stays with the technician. The compiler's runtime is not this labour.

reach.task: Hand over a component this technician is integrating.
reach.learn: An architecture title is not the integration.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored architecture is a lookup. It does not integrate a software or hardware component.
Time a compiler or controller already spends running is not the technician's integration labour.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.
Fields: The architecture id already stored. The screen does not mark a component integrated. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the architecture before the integration.
A test station, drawing tool, controller, bill generator, or statistical program that already runs is not in these shares.
unknowns: Whether software and hardware components share one architecture record.
research_questions: Who confirms the architecture matches the unit now being integrated?

already_counted.description: Integrating the components stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop architectures whose unit record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still integrates the software or hardware components on the computer, microprocessor, or control architecture. Only opening an architecture that was already written is removed. A compiler or controller that already runs saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Show the stored functional deviation on this prototype.
Modify electrical prototypes or assemblies to correct deviations.

tasks.design: The {DOCS} store shows the functional deviation already written for this electrical prototype, part, assembly, or system. The engineering technician modifies it to correct the deviation. The note does not make the change. A note with no id leaves the correction with the technician.
tasks.previous_blocker: A prototype was marked corrected because a deviation title existed, and the assembly had not been modified.
tasks.enabler_now: The stored deviation can be opened. The modification still belongs to the technician.
tasks.still_hard: A deviation the note does not describe still has to be found on the prototype.
tasks.human_edge: The technician corrects the deviation. The note is not the modification.
tasks.altitude: The modification stays with the technician. The stored note is only visible.

reach.task: Use a prototype this technician has corrected.
reach.learn: A deviation title is not the correction.

evidence.claim: Opening a stored deviation is a lookup. It does not modify a prototype, part, assembly, or system.
Marking a title closed does not correct a functional deviation.

assumptions: Workflow boundary: An engineering technician in a mid-size European company. A stored drawing is not the circuit, and a draft is not the accepted record.

Fields: The deviation id and the note already written. The screen does not mark the prototype corrected. If a required field is missing, the step stops and the engineering technician finishes it by hand.
Native check: Open the deviation note before the modification.
unknowns: Whether prototype deviations and assembly deviations share one note.
research_questions: Who confirms the note matches the prototype now on the bench?

already_counted.description: Modifying the prototype or assembly to correct the deviation stays with the technician.

incremental.description: Drop notes whose prototype record has been withdrawn.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: The technician still modifies the electrical prototype, part, assembly, or system to correct the functional deviation. Only opening a note that was already written is removed. A deviation title saves none of that work.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The engineering technician still reviews the maintenance standard, still replaces the part, still integrates the component, and still corrects the prototype. A stored note can be opened. It does not do the hands-on work.
reach: Maintainers use a standard this technician has accepted, and a note is not the standard.
Engineers hear that a deviation was corrected by this technician, not by a title.
skills_to_grow: Keep a sentence in a standard only when a held note states it.
Replace the defective part by hand. The instrument's reading is not the replacement.
Integrate and correct on the bench. A compiler that already runs is not this labour.
role.ambitious_version: Standards, replacement, integration, and correction stay with the technician. Stored notes only show what was already written.

job.title: Electrical and Electronic Engineering Technologists and Technicians
